normalized_mass_low_g.description: Card 16-B Intervals: normalized_mass_low_g (QNT v0 has scalar mass_g only). null = UNKNOWN, never 0.

normalized_mass_high_g.description: Card 16-B Intervals: normalized_mass_high_g. null = UNKNOWN, never 0.

intervals.description: Card 16-B Intervals: ranges stay ranges; the three interval kinds are separate records, never collapsed. Quantile level structure for EMPIRICAL_QUANTILES is not given by the card.

ast.description: Card 16-B Structure: quantity AST root (nodes RATIONAL, RANGE, ADD, MULTIPLY, FRACTION_OF, REMAINDER_OF, PACKAGE_CONTENT, ALTERNATIVE, QUALITATIVE, OPEN_AMOUNT, UNKNOWN). ALTERNATIVE is never multiplied/summed (semantic rule, not schema-expressible).

measured_state.description: Card 16-B Structure: measured_state (1 cup cooked rice != raw). Vocabulary not in card; free string, null = UNKNOWN.

as_purchased_vs_edible.description: Card 16-B Structure: as_purchased_vs_edible. Value vocabulary not in card; free string, null = UNKNOWN.

multiplier.description: Card 16-B Structure: multiplier (2 x 400 g). null = absent/UNKNOWN.

dual_expression_check.description: Card 16-B Structure: dual_expression_check ('1 cup (240 ml)', flag on conflict). Object shape is a draft choice.

locale_evidence.description: Card 16-B Locale/era: locale_evidence (no authoritative source for katori/glass; interval with evidence or UNKNOWN).

unit_system_era.description: Card 16-B Locale/era: unit_system_era; historical units never forced to modern FDC portions.

ast_node.description: Card 16-B Structure: AST node. Per-type payload fields are not specified by the card; only generic slots (value/low/high/raw/children) are offered.

allOf.$comment: Card 16-B: qualitative stays qualitative; encoders use masks, never zeros.
Card 16-B Ladder: Q6 = UNKNOWN; invented grams = 0.
Card 16-B Invented grams = 0: a gram value at Q1-Q4 must trace to a POR record (Q0 is arithmetic). Q5 left open (only if task permits).
